ops.text: A gap of comparable size has been found with genuine $\ket{T}$-state simulations of the 17-qubit colour-code circuit CC17 [⟦new.B2⟧].

For comparison, the exact $\ket{T}$ logical error rate reported for the CC17 colour-code circuit at the same $p$ is $2.8\times 10^{-9}$ [⟦new.B2⟧], so Rot5, at $8.1\times 10^{-10}$, lies a factor of $\sim 3.5$ below it despite its partially fault-tolerant S gate.

new_bib.text: E. Whitfield, C. Ashby, S. Hargreaves, R. Lyons, and A. Pellow (2026). Exact non-Clifford simulation of colour-code magic state cultivation under hardware-motivated noise. arXiv.
